workarounds.symptom: hub stamps 'daemonless' on a failed saved-history fallback while a daemon is still running, and the client reads it as proof of absence
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(hub): stamp unknown owner on a failed saved-history fallback (#6815). Target files: appwire/boot_generation.go, cmd/evener-hub/app_restart_required.go, cmd/evener-hub/app_rpc.go. `appwire.UnknownOwnerBootGeneration = "unknown-owner"` (`appwire/boot_generation.go:36`) means **the saved-history fallback failed and the serving daemon was never established**. A failed read's only evidence about ownership is that it failed, so it cannot support `daemonless`, which claims no daemon is running for the session. (Ref: https://github.com/prime-radiant-inc/evener/pull/6828)

Target files: agent/internal/tool/registry.go, agent/internal/tool/registry_test.go. `tool.Registry.Clone` copied the tool map with `maps.Copy`, which copies each `RegisteredTool` struct.
